question: Why can teacher not edit Announcements (Connection lost) in UntisX (endpoint /students)?
answer: Check role teacher. Module Announcements may require higher permissions. Error Connection lost: on 401/403 check credentials and tab permissions, on 404 check the route in App.tsx/AppNavigation.kt, on 500 check server logs and database, on timeout check the Docker container and network. Validate endpoint /students and the database connection. Feature Multilingual support must be enabled.
